name: Torch
flavorText: A wooden handle wrapped in oil-soaked cloth. Burns for about an hour.

name: Rope, Hempen (50 ft.)
flavorText: Sturdy hempen rope, coiled. Fraying at one end but still reliable.

name: Iron Rations (1 day)
flavorText: Hard tack and dried salted meat in a wax block.

name: Waterskin
flavorText: A tanned leather pouch sealed with a cork. Holds about a quart.

name: Tinderbox
flavorText: A small tin with flint, steel, and charcloth for starting fires.

name: Bandage Roll
flavorText: Strips of linen on a small spool. For binding wounds.

name: Wooden Stake
flavorText: A sharpened length of ash wood.

name: Small Mirror
flavorText: A palm-sized disc of polished tin.

name: Candle
flavorText: A stub of tallow candle, maybe two inches tall.

name: Chalk
flavorText: A short stick of white chalk.

name: Sack
flavorText: A coarse burlap bag large enough for a haul of loot.

name: Crowbar
flavorText: A foot-long iron pry bar with a curved forked end.

name: Grappling Hook
flavorText: Four iron claws on a central ring. Attach a rope and throw.

name: Handaxe
flavorText: A single-bladed hatchet with a worn hickory handle.

name: Dagger
flavorText: A double-edged blade about a foot long with a simple crossguard.

name: Sling
flavorText: A braided leather strip with a small pouch. Can fling stones lethally.

name: Pouch of Copper Coins (20 cp)
flavorText: A drawstring leather pouch containing roughly 20 copper pieces.

name: Rusty Key
flavorText: An old iron key, heavily corroded. May fit a lock — or be useless.

name: Wool Cloak
flavorText: A plain grey wool cloak with a bone clasp.

name: Bedroll
flavorText: A rolled blanket of wool and canvas.

name: Whetstone
flavorText: A flat rectangular stone of fine grit.

name: Iron Spikes (bundle of 6)
flavorText: Six iron spikes with flat heads.

name: Lantern, Hooded
flavorText: A tin lantern with a hinged glass panel.

name: Flask of Oil
flavorText: A small clay flask of lamp oil.

name: Belt Pouch
flavorText: A small leather pouch that clips onto a belt.

name: Iron Pot
flavorText: A squat cast-iron cooking pot, blackened from countless fires.

name: Quill and Ink
flavorText: A goose feather quill and a vial of dark ink.

name: Blank Parchment (sheet)
flavorText: A single sheet of rough parchment, slightly yellowed.

name: Dried Herbs (bundle)
flavorText: Dried herbs tied with twine. Possibly culinary, possibly medicinal.

name: Pouch of Salt
flavorText: Coarse salt in a waxed linen pouch.

name: Small Bell
flavorText: A brass bell about the size of a thumb with a clear ring.

name: Wire Snare
flavorText: A loop of thin brass wire on a length of cord.

name: Bone Whistle
flavorText: A short whistle carved from a hollow bone.

name: Beeswax Block
flavorText: A thumb-sized block of golden beeswax.

name: Dried Mushroom
flavorText: A large mushroom, dried. May be edible — or mildly toxic.

name: Rough Map Fragment
flavorText: A torn corner of a map in faded ink, showing corridors and a room with an X.

name: Sling Stone
flavorText: A smooth disc-shaped river stone perfectly sized for a sling.

name: Crude Map
flavorText: A rough sketch on a leather scrap showing a corridor and a door marked with a skull.

name: Cracked Wooden Shield
flavorText: A wooden shield with a split across the face.

name: Worn Leather Armor
flavorText: Soft leather armor, scuffed and scratched.

name: Shortbow
flavorText: A simple wooden shortbow, unstrung.

name: Quiver of Arrows (20)
flavorText: A leather quiver holding twenty standard fletched arrows.

name: Club
flavorText: A stout length of hardwood, heavy at one end.

name: Spear
flavorText: A six-foot ash shaft tipped with an iron point.

name: Javelin
flavorText: A short light throwing spear.

name: Quarterstaff
flavorText: A sturdy six-foot hardwood staff.

name: Pouch of Silver Coins (5 sp)
flavorText: A small cloth pouch with five silver pieces.

name: Common Clothes (Set)
flavorText: Plain unremarkable traveler's clothes.

name: Mending Kit
flavorText: A bone needle, two spools of thread, and a thimble.

name: Fishing Line and Hook
flavorText: A spool of thin cord with a small hook.

name: Small Knife
flavorText: A short single-edged knife for eating or whittling.

name: Crumpled Letter
flavorText: A folded piece of parchment, sweat-stained and read many times. The handwriting is careful but the ink is blurred in one corner, as though it got wet once.

name: Wax-Sealed Note
flavorText: A small folded parchment sealed with dark red wax bearing a thumbprint instead of a sigil. Whoever sealed it had no ring.

name: Wanted Poster (Folded)
flavorText: A broadsheet printed with a woodblock illustration and a name. Someone has been carrying this. The face has been crossed out with charcoal.

name: Half-Written Journal
flavorText: A pocket-sized book with a cracked spine. About a third of the pages are written in a small cramped hand. The last entry is dated three days ago.

name: Folded Map (Personal)
flavorText: A hand-drawn map on folded cloth, worn at the creases. Shows roads, a town, and a route with a destination marked by a simple house symbol.

name: Tally Stick
flavorText: A stick of ash wood notched with dozens of small cuts. A counting record — debts, days, or kills. No way to know which.

name: Brass Ring
flavorText: A plain brass ring, thin and worn smooth. It fits a finger smaller than yours. The inside is engraved with two initials and a date.

name: Locket (Empty)
flavorText: A small oval locket on a thin chain, silver-plated over brass. The hinge still works. Whatever was inside it is gone.

name: Locket with Portrait
flavorText: A small oval locket on a brass chain. Inside is a tiny painted miniature of a woman or man — the paint is faded but the face is clear.

name: Worn Wedding Band
flavorText: A plain iron band, slightly oval from years of wear. It left a mark on the finger that was wearing it.

name: Saint's Token
flavorText: A small lead disc stamped with a crudely rendered saint figure on one side. A hole has been drilled through for a cord, long since lost.

name: Carved Bone Charm
flavorText: A small animal carved from a finger bone — a rabbit, a fish, or a bird — worn smooth from handling. Likely a luck charm.

name: Lock of Hair (Tied)
flavorText: A small bundle of dark hair tied tightly with a red thread. Someone kept this deliberately.

name: Pressed Flower
flavorText: A dried wildflower pressed flat between two pieces of stiff leather. It's been there long enough to leave a faint stain.

name: Small Painted Stone
flavorText: A smooth river stone with a simple face painted on it in faded colour — a child's project, or a parent's keepsake.

name: Pewter Drinking Flask
flavorText: A flat pewter flask that fits a coat pocket. Dented along one side. Still smells faintly of whatever was last in it.

name: Carved Pipe
flavorText: A short briar pipe with a worn stem. The bowl is darkened from use. A thin layer of ash remains inside.

name: Pocket Knife
flavorText: A small folding knife with a horn handle and a blade barely three inches long. The blade is a little rusty near the hinge.

name: Whetstone (Small)
flavorText: A palm-sized rectangle of grey stone, smooth on both sides from years of use. Fits in a belt pouch.

name: Ball of Twine
flavorText: A ball of coarse brown twine about the size of a fist, wound tightly. Maybe 30 feet of it, maybe 40. Hard to tell.

name: Sewing Needle and Thread
flavorText: A single steel needle and a small spool of black thread, wrapped together in a scrap of leather.

name: Bar of Soap
flavorText: A grey block of lye soap, nearly used down. Still useful. Smells vaguely of tallow.

name: Iron Comb
flavorText: A rough iron comb with half its teeth intact. Someone used it regularly — it's worn smooth at the spine.

name: Small Scissors
flavorText: Tiny iron scissors, hinged in the middle. Slightly misaligned but still functional for cutting thread, trimming nails, or cutting purse strings.

name: Copper Thimble
flavorText: A battered copper thimble with a dent in the side. Someone wore this while working.

name: Tinned Salve
flavorText: A small round tin containing a waxy yellowish salve. It smells medicinal — pine tar and something sharper.

name: Stub of Sealing Wax
flavorText: A finger-length stub of dark red sealing wax, half-used.

name: Folded Cloth Bandage
flavorText: A strip of clean linen, folded into a neat square and tucked into a coat pocket. Somebody had the foresight to carry it.

name: Small Tin of Charcoal Sticks
flavorText: A hinged tin holding four short sticks of compressed charcoal, wrapped in cloth to prevent smudging.

name: Half-Eaten Ration
flavorText: A wax-wrapped block of salt meat and hard biscuit, half consumed. The remaining portion is still sealed and edible.

name: Piece of Dried Fruit
flavorText: A handful of dried plums or apricots in a small cloth bag, sticky and dense. Someone packed these for the road.

name: Wax-Wrapped Cheese
flavorText: A wedge of hard cheese, wrapped in cloth and sealed with wax. Pungent but edible. Probably better than most things found in a dungeon.

name: Corked Vial of Spirits
flavorText: A finger-sized glass vial of clear or amber spirits, tightly corked. Strong enough to sterilize a wound.

name: Lump of Hard Candy
flavorText: A knot of dark brown sugar candy wrapped in waxed paper. Slightly sticky at the seams.

name: Pouch of Trail Mix
flavorText: A small drawstring pouch holding a handful of dried nuts, seeds, and raisins.

name: Handful of Mixed Coins
flavorText: A handful of assorted coinage — a few coppers, a silver, possibly a foreign coin of unclear denomination.

name: Single Gold Coin
flavorText: One gold piece, heavier than expected. The stamp is worn but shows a ruler's profile.

name: Beggar's Purse
flavorText: A tiny leather purse holding almost nothing — a few copper pieces and a button.

name: Foreign Coin
flavorText: A coin of unusual shape and metal — octagonal, or with a hole through the center, or stamped in a script no one here reads.

name: Hidden Cache Note
flavorText: A scrap of parchment with a number and a symbol — not a map, but a reference to something buried, hidden, or deposited somewhere.

name: Spare Boot (Single)
flavorText: A single boot, worn down on the outside heel. No partner. Someone wore this regularly and then, at some point, lost track of its pair.

name: Pair of Wool Socks
flavorText: A pair of thick wool socks, hand-knitted. One has been darned at the heel twice.

name: Patched Scarf
flavorText: A long wool scarf, dyed a faded blue-green, with a repair near one end in a slightly different shade of thread.

name: Worn Work Gloves
flavorText: Heavy leather gloves stiff with dried labor — resin, blood, or grease, hard to tell which.

name: Folded Headscarf
flavorText: A square of cotton cloth, faded and fraying at two corners. Can be worn many ways.

name: Pewter Belt Buckle
flavorText: A plain pewter buckle, still attached to a short length of old leather strap. The leather snapped; the buckle survived.

name: Pair of Bone Dice
flavorText: Two six-sided dice carved from bone. The pips are inked in black. One die is very slightly weighted — DC 15 Investigation to notice, DC 20 to be certain.

name: Deck of Playing Cards
flavorText: A worn deck of thirty-two hand-painted cards, dog-eared on the same four cards from years of use. Missing one.

name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
flavorText: A dried rabbit's foot on a leather cord, stiff with age. Missing two of its claws.

name: Small Iron Padlock (No Key)
flavorText: A working padlock with a shackle that opens and closes properly. No key. Whoever had this lost it or had a reason to keep the lock separate.

name: Etched Tin Cup
flavorText: A dented tin drinking cup with a name scratched into the bottom in rough letters.

name: Small Wooden Toy
flavorText: A simple carved wooden figure — a horse, a soldier, a rabbit — about the size of a hand. The paint is mostly worn off.

name: Bottle of Ink (Half-Empty)
flavorText: A small glass bottle of dark ink, stoppered with a cork. About half remains. The cork has dried ink on its edges.

name: Scrap of Foreign Cloth
flavorText: A palm-sized piece of richly colored silk or patterned cotton, torn unevenly — cut from something larger. Used as a handkerchief or keepsake.

name: Almanac (Previous Year)
flavorText: A small printed almanac for the previous year — weather predictions, market days, tide tables, holy days. Someone's made notes in the margins.

name: Pouch of Pipe Weed
flavorText: A small leather pouch of dried, shredded herb. Opens to a mild, sweet smell. Enough for several pipes.

name: Stub of Charcoal Pencil
flavorText: A charcoal writing stick wrapped in cord, about half its original length.

name: Small Hand Mirror
flavorText: A bronze-backed mirror with a handle, small enough to fit in a coat pocket. The reflection is slightly warped near one edge.

name: Dog-Eared Chapbook
flavorText: A cheap printed pamphlet of maybe twenty pages — a popular story, a religious tract, or a bawdy song collection. Well-read.

name: Merchant's Receipt
flavorText: A stamped piece of parchment recording a transaction at a named shop in a named town. The amount is legible.

name: Small Compass
flavorText: A cheap brass compass with a slightly sticky needle. It's accurate but slow — takes 5 seconds to settle after being moved.

name: Worn Leather Notebook
flavorText: A soft leather cover around thirty or forty folded pages, tied shut with a cord. About half the pages are used.

name: Bundle of Tallow Candles (3)
flavorText: Three short tallow candles bundled together with a twist of string. Smell of rendered fat.

name: Pouch of Dried Lavender
flavorText: A small cloth sachet of dried lavender, sewn shut. Still fragrant.

name: Iron Fishhook (3)
flavorText: Three plain iron fishhooks in a small cloth wrap, sized for freshwater fish.

name: Traveler's Prayer Beads
flavorText: A string of twelve wooden beads on a knotted cord, with a single larger bead at one end carved with a simple religious symbol.

name: Knucklebone Set (4)
flavorText: Four polished knucklebones — ankle bones from a sheep, used as primitive dice or for the game of jacks.

name: Iron Plate Armor
flavorText: Full plate forged from iron, fitted to cover the torso, shoulders, and hips.

name: Iron Plate Helm
flavorText: A full-face iron helm matched to a plate armor set.

name: Iron Plate Gauntlets
flavorText: Articulated iron gauntlets, hinged at the knuckles for a full grip.

name: Iron Plate Greaves
flavorText: Iron greaves covering the thighs and shins, buckled at the sides.

name: Iron Plate Boots
flavorText: Reinforced iron sabatons with articulated toe plates.

name: Iron Plate Shield
flavorText: A kite shield of solid iron, sized to match a full plate ensemble.

name: Iron Shortsword
flavorText: A iron a short, balanced blade suited to quick strikes.

name: Iron Longsword
flavorText: A iron a straight double-edged blade about a yard long.

name: Iron Dagger
flavorText: A iron a short double-edged blade with a simple crossguard.

name: Iron Mace
flavorText: A iron a flanged metal head on a sturdy haft.

name: Iron Battleaxe
flavorText: A iron a broad single-bladed axe head on a long haft.

name: Iron Warhammer
flavorText: A iron a heavy square hammerhead built for crushing blows.

name: Iron Spear
flavorText: A iron a long haft tipped with a leaf-shaped point.

name: Barn Cat
flavorText: A lean tabby cat that follows at a comfortable distance and only comes close when it wants something.

unlocks.condition: Let the cat single-handedly clear a room, cellar, or ship's hold of a full vermin infestation.
unlocks.reward: The Perception advantage now extends to a 30-ft radius even when the cat isn't actively investigating, and it reliably lets you know the moment it senses something worth noticing.

name: Messenger Pigeon
flavorText: A gray pigeon with a leg band, trained to fly to a known location and back.

unlocks.condition: Have the pigeon successfully deliver a message across genuinely hazardous territory (a storm, a warzone, hostile terrain) and return safely.
unlocks.reward: Range extends to 10 miles, the pigeon can find you anywhere within that range even if you've since moved, and it always returns the same day.

name: Mutt Puppy
flavorText: A scruffy mixed-breed puppy with floppy ears and boundless energy.

unlocks.condition: The puppy warns you of danger — growling, barking, or otherwise — before you noticed it yourself.
unlocks.reward: +1 Charisma. The advantage now also applies to Animal Handling checks, and the puppy has grown fiercely protective, placing itself between you and an obvious threat unasked.

name: Field Mouse
flavorText: A tiny brown mouse that rides in a pocket or sleeve without complaint.

unlocks.tierLabel: Hidden Power — Braver Than It Looks
unlocks.condition: Use the mouse to retrieve or scout something in a situation where being caught would have been genuinely dangerous.
unlocks.reward: The mouse can now carry a small key, note, or trinket along with it, and can be directed toward a general location rather than only a specific object you can already see.

name: Garden Toad
flavorText: A fat speckled toad that eats bugs and croaks when it senses rain.

unlocks.condition: Correctly heed the toad's warning to avoid a serious problem — a storm, a flash flood, or similar.
unlocks.reward: Forecasting range extends to 24 hours, and it can now also sense standing magical weather effects (a fog cloud, a controlled climate) within a mile.

name: Weasel
flavorText: A quick, curious weasel with sharp eyes and an opportunistic streak.

unlocks.tierLabel: Hidden Power — Quick Fingers, Quick Paws
unlocks.condition: Use the weasel's distraction to pull off a genuinely difficult theft or escape.
unlocks.reward: +1 Dexterity. The weasel can now also retrieve a small unattended item during its distraction, on top of just creating the opening.

name: Crow
flavorText: A glossy black crow that mimics sounds and remembers faces.

unlocks.condition: The crow correctly warns you about someone it recognized as dangerous from a past encounter.
unlocks.reward: Memory extends to roughly 30 individuals, and it can now mimic a short phrase (a few words) convincingly enough to fool someone who isn't listening closely.

name: Hedgehog
flavorText: A small spiny hedgehog that curls into a ball at the slightest provocation.

unlocks.condition: Survive an ambush during a rest specifically because the hedgehog's warning gave you the edge.
unlocks.reward: +1 Constitution. The advantage on waking to danger now applies to every rest, not just the first check, for as long as the hedgehog is near.

name: Tamed Housefly Swarm
flavorText: An unsettling but harmless cloud of flies that hovers near its owner and no one else.

unlocks.condition: Resist or recover from a serious disease while the swarm was present.
unlocks.reward: The advantage on disease saves extends to poison saves as well — the flies, it turns out, aren't picky about what they clean up.

name: Ferret
flavorText: A long, wriggly ferret that loves tunnels, sleeves, and other people's pockets.

unlocks.condition: The ferret retrieves something genuinely important from a spot no one else could have reached.
unlocks.reward: The ferret can now navigate and retrieve from spaces up to 60 ft. away without direct supervision, working purely off your description of where to look.

name: Imprinted Duckling
flavorText: An imprinted duckling that believes its owner is its parent, permanently.

unlocks.condition: The duckling's alert saves the party from a genuine ambush during a rest.
unlocks.reward: +1 Wisdom. Alert range extends to 60 feet, and it now reacts distinctly to a creature it has been alerted to before, so you know when it's the same threat returning.

name: Chicken
flavorText: An unbothered hen that lays an egg most mornings, war or no war.

unlocks.condition: Use the chicken's egg to solve a problem in a moment that actually mattered.
unlocks.reward: The hen now lays two eggs some days instead of one, and can be prompted to lay on demand once per day instead of waiting for morning.

name: Black Housecat
flavorText: A sleek black cat with unnervingly intelligent eyes.

unlocks.condition: Use the cat's presence to successfully intimidate a genuinely superstitious foe or crowd.
unlocks.reward: +1 Charisma. The Intimidation advantage now applies against any creature, superstitious or not — something about this particular cat is just unsettling.

name: Old Tortoise
flavorText: A slow, patient tortoise that has clearly seen a few things.

unlocks.tierLabel: Hidden Power — Seen It All Before
unlocks.condition: Keep your nerve in a moment of real danger specifically because of the tortoise's calming presence.
unlocks.reward: The calm extends to a 15-ft radius rather than just within reach, and the advantage against fear now covers the whole party in that radius.

name: Songbird
flavorText: A small finch with a surprisingly complex song.

unlocks.tierLabel: Hidden Power — A Song Worth Hearing
unlocks.condition: Use the songbird's song to turn around a camp that had genuinely lost hope.
unlocks.reward: The song can be called on twice between rests instead of once, and grants advantage on the next TWO morale-raising Charisma checks instead of one.

name: Clever Sewer Rat
flavorText: A surprisingly sharp-eyed sewer rat that's learned a few tricks.

unlocks.condition: Use the rat to scout a path that saved the party from a serious trap or ambush.
unlocks.reward: Reports become more detailed — it can now indicate rough distances and simple hazards (water, fire, a locked door) with its trained gestures, not just point out a safe path.

name: Riding Pony
flavorText: A sturdy, even-tempered pony suited for a Small rider or light loads.

unlocks.condition: Ride the pony through a genuinely dangerous situation and keep it calm.
unlocks.reward: Speed increases to 50 ft., and the pony no longer needs a check to remain steady near loud or frightening stimuli.

name: Draft Mule
flavorText: A patient, hard-working mule, better suited to hauling than speed.

unlocks.condition: The mule hauls a genuinely overloaded burden through difficult terrain without faltering.
unlocks.reward: Carrying capacity increases to 600 lbs. without penalty, and the sure-footed advantage now also applies to the rider's own checks to stay mounted on rough ground.

name: Riding Horse
flavorText: A calm, reliable horse, unremarkable except for its dependability.

unlocks.condition: Ride the horse hard across real distance in a genuine emergency, and take care of it properly afterward.
unlocks.reward: Speed increases to 70 ft., and the horse gains enough stamina that a long, hard ride on it no longer wears it — or its rider — down as quickly.

name: Mountain Goat
flavorText: A surefooted mountain goat, small enough for a halfling or gnome to ride comfortably.

unlocks.condition: Cross terrain on the goat that should have been impassable, and survive it.
unlocks.reward: Climb speed increases to 40 ft., and the advantage against falling or being knocked prone extends to the rider even when not directly on the goat, so long as they're within 5 ft. of it.

name: Traveler's Journal
flavorText: A worn leather-bound journal, its pages full of a stranger's cramped handwriting — travel routes, weather notes, and the occasional worried aside about being followed.

name: Cartographer's Dungeon Map
flavorText: A hand-inked map of a specific dungeon or ruin, corners curled from handling.

name: Stack of Gold Coins
flavorText: A neat stack of coins bearing the crest of a kingdom that may or may not still exist.

name: Chipped Rose Quartz
flavorText: A fist-sized chunk of rose quartz, cloudy and imperfect but still pretty enough to sell.

name: Corroded Vault Key
flavorText: A heavy iron key, rusted nearly solid. Whatever it opens hasn't been touched in a long time.

name: Bloodstained Evidence Cloth
flavorText: A torn scrap of fabric, stained dark. Someone will want to know where this was found.

name: Cartographer's Surveying Set
flavorText: A brass sighting scope, a set of measuring chains, and a well-used sketchbook.

name: Traveling Minstrel's Lute
flavorText: A well-traveled lute with a few new scars but a still-true sound.

name: Carved Wooden Idol
flavorText: A small idol carved from dark wood, worn smooth at the base from generations of hands.

name: Dusty Porcelain Figurine
flavorText: A painted porcelain figurine of a shepherdess, missing one hand.

name: Set of Carved Game Pieces
flavorText: A dozen small carved pieces for a strategy game, missing their board.

name: Chipped Clay Mug
flavorText: A plain clay mug with a chip in the rim, otherwise perfectly serviceable.

name: Potion of Healing
flavorText: A glass vial of faintly glowing pink liquid with a sweet, coppery taste.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
flavorText: A vibrant red potion, noticeably warmer than it should be.

name: Silver Dagger
flavorText: A slender dagger with a pure silver blade, polished to a mirror sheen.

name: Thieves' Tools
flavorText: A leather roll with picks, tension wrenches, and a mirror on wire.

name: Climber's Kit
flavorText: Iron pitons, a small hammer, and spiked leather gloves.

name: Damaged Spellbook
flavorText: A water-damaged tome with half its pages stuck together. Legible spells remain.

name: Potion of Darkvision
flavorText: A murky grey liquid in a stoppered bottle.

name: Rope of Entangling
flavorText: A coil of silky rope that seems to tighten knots on its own.

name: Gloves of the Thief
flavorText: Thin black leather gloves that leave no fingerprints.

name: Amulet of Natural Armor +1
flavorText: A flat disc of iron engraved with a protective rune.

name: Ring of Warmth
flavorText: A plain bronze ring that radiates gentle heat.

name: Vial of Antitoxin
flavorText: A clear bitter liquid that neutralizes common poisons.

name: Oil of Slipperiness
flavorText: A viscous clear oil. Applied to skin or surface, grip becomes near impossible.

name: Dust of Disappearance
flavorText: Iridescent grey powder in a wax envelope.

name: Bag of Holding
flavorText: A cloth bag whose interior is far larger than its exterior.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
flavorText: Soft leather boots stitched with leaf patterns.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
flavorText: A mottled green-grey cloak that shifts to match surroundings.

name: Goggles of Night
flavorText: Brass-framed goggles with dark amber lenses.

name: Potion of Water Breathing
flavorText: A blue slightly fizzy liquid.

name: Potion of Climbing
flavorText: A thick amber potion smelling of pine sap.

name: Longsword +1
flavorText: A well-crafted longsword with faint runes along the blade.

name: Shield +1
flavorText: A round iron shield with subtle magical reinforcement.

name: Mithral Chain Shirt
flavorText: A shirt of interlocking mithral rings, incredibly light and silent.

name: Silver Holy Symbol
flavorText: A finely cast silver symbol on a chain.

name: Scroll of Fireball
flavorText: Parchment inscribed with a glowing sigil. Reading it unleashes a sphere of flame.

name: Scroll of Invisibility
flavorText: A vellum scroll turning one creature invisible for up to one hour.

name: Portable Ram
flavorText: A compact iron-shod battering ram with folding handles.

name: Sending Stones (pair)
flavorText: Two smooth stones carved with the same rune.

name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
flavorText: A volatile green liquid that ignites when shattered.

name: Thunderstone
flavorText: A grey stone that detonates with a concussive thunderclap when thrown.

name: Tanglefoot Bag
flavorText: A sack of viscous goo. When burst it roots the target in place.

name: Smokestick
flavorText: A wax-coated rod that produces dense grey smoke when snapped.

name: Masterwork Longsword
flavorText: A sword crafted by a skilled smith with exceptional balance. Not magical.

name: Masterwork Heavy Crossbow
flavorText: A finely made heavy crossbow with a cranked loading mechanism.

name: Eternal Lantern
flavorText: A brass lantern whose flame never gutters or runs dry.

name: Lock of Eternal Binding
flavorText: A padlock that cannot be picked or forced — only the correct key opens it.

name: Potion of Heroism
flavorText: A bright red potion that tastes of iron and pepper.

name: Bracers of Armor (+1)
flavorText: Iron bracers inscribed with interlocking shields.

name: Ring of Feather Falling
flavorText: A silver ring set with a tiny white feather.

name: Potion of Enlarge
flavorText: A red syrupy liquid.

name: Potion of Reduce
flavorText: A blue watery potion.

name: Necklace of Fireballs
flavorText: A beaded necklace with 1d6+1 beads that explode as fireballs.

name: Hat of Disguise
flavorText: An unremarkable hat that alters the wearer's appearance when worn.

name: Pipes of the Sewers
flavorText: Carved bone pipes. Playing them summons swarms of rats.

name: Gem of Brightness
flavorText: A clear crystal that emits a blinding burst of light.

name: Eyes of Minute Seeing
flavorText: Crystal lenses on a wire frame that reveal fine detail.

name: Circlet of Blasting

name: The Black Books' Missing Page
flavorText: A single page torn from an Ashcrown court ledger, its entries written in a cramped, meticulous hand — a partial list of names, sums, and dates, each corresponding to a debt called in against a sitting Imperial official.

name: The Ashbond's Sealed Devotee Rolls
flavorText: A leather-bound register of Ashbond followers marked for a 'sacred pilgrimage,' cross-referenced against a second list of names quietly struck through — every one of them reported missing by their families within the same season.

name: Second Flame Signal Whistle
flavorText: A small bone whistle, carved rather than cast, tuned to a pitch just past what most ears register as sound. Rebel scouts carry these on long patrols — a whistle nobody outside the Second Flame knows to listen for.

name: Cassia's Deepening Records
flavorText: A private, meticulously kept journal in Firewarden Cassia Emberlyn's own hand, recording the name, preparation, and outcome of every Ashbond 'Deepening' ceremony she has personally overseen. Not a record she's ever shown anyone — least of all Zaharos.

name: The Vane Locket
flavorText: A tarnished silver locket holding two painted portraits — a boy and a girl, no older than ten, both smiling in a way neither sibling quite manages anymore. Grand Inquisitor Vane hasn't opened it in over a decade. He hasn't thrown it away either.

name: Aldric's Unsent Letter
flavorText: A folded letter in the Crown Prince's own hand, addressed to no one, admitting more about where his allowance actually goes than he's ever said aloud. It reads like something written to be burned, not sent — and never was.

name: Old Marrow's Service Record
flavorText: An official Ashcrown military file, decades old, water-stained and half-illegible — a Cinder Coast rebel listed as confirmed executed, complete with General Korrin's own signature on the report.

name: Elder Runes Deck
flavorText: Twelve thin stones, each etched with the mark of an animal or element and worn smooth by hands long dead. Unlike the wilder fate-decks of the world, this one doesn't ask for anything in return — it just lends its strength for a while.

flavorText: Well-worn tower shield, clearly built by someone who understood the deep frost better than most.

unlocks.condition: Be the last person standing in 3 separate combat encounters while wearing this piece.
unlocks.reward: The armor's protective bonus sharpens: advantage on one additional category of saving throw of your choice, and its signature effect can be used one additional time before requiring a rest.

legacySource.name: Adamantine Tower Shield of the Deep Frost

name: Ring of Invisibility
flavorText: A thin, unremarkable band that seems to catch the eye less than it should.

name: Scimitar of Speed
flavorText: A curved blade so perfectly balanced it seems to move before the wielder decides to swing it.

name: Wand of Polymorph
flavorText: A twisted wand carved from a single piece of bone that was never entirely one shape to begin with.

name: Horn of Valhalla (Bronze)
flavorText: A great curling warhorn, its bronze surface etched with the marching forms of ancient soldiers.

name: Mirror of Life Trapping
flavorText: A tall, ornate mirror in a gilded frame, its surface a little too still to be simple glass.

name: Carpet of Flying (6 ft. x 9 ft.)
flavorText: A densely woven flying carpet, large enough to comfortably seat a small party.

legacySource.name: Carpet of Flying (6 ft. x 9 ft.)

name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
flavorText: A set of four horseshoes, each impossibly light and faintly warm, as though touched by open sky.

name: Universal Solvent
flavorText: A single vial of clear, faintly shimmering liquid, kept sealed against its own restless nature.

name: Sword of Sharpness
flavorText: A longsword honed to an edge that doesn't so much cut as simply agree to no longer be attached.

name: Animated Shield
flavorText: A round shield that, once bonded to its bearer, no longer needs a hand to hold it up.

name: Demon Armor (Cursed)
flavorText: Blackened plate armor, its pauldrons shaped like leering, horned faces that seem to shift when unwatched.

name: Dwarven Plate
flavorText: Masterwork plate armor forged in the old dwarven style, every joint and plate fitted with uncanny precision.

name: Plate Armor of Etherealness
flavorText: Ornate, silver-chased plate armor that seems, at certain angles, slightly less solid than it should.

name: Emberfang, the Wyrmslayer Blade
flavorText: A massive greatsword forged from the fang of an ancient red wyrm and quenched in its own blood.

unlocks.condition: Deal 500 total fire damage using this weapon across any number of encounters.
unlocks.reward: +1d6 fire damage permanently on all hits. The blade stays visibly orange-hot for 10 minutes after each kill.

unlocks.condition: Kill a true dragon (CR 10+) with this blade as the killing blow.
unlocks.reward: Dragon Terror Aura: all dragons within 60 ft. make DC 16 Wisdom save or become Frightened until they leave the radius. You are permanently immune to dragon Frightful Presence.

unlocks.condition: Kill 3 true dragons with this blade as the killing blow. The third dragon's soul is consumed.
unlocks.reward: The blade becomes Sentient (Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 18) and craves dragon blood. If no dragon is killed within 30 days, it attacks allies. When fed: advantage on all attack rolls for 1 hour after each dragon kill. +5 attack and damage against dragons permanently.

name: Widow's Whisper
flavorText: A slender rapier engraved with a name that has been scratched out.

unlocks.condition: Win 10 single-combat duels (one-on-one, no ally intervention) using this blade.
unlocks.reward: Whisper's Edge: attacks with this weapon cannot be parried. +1d4 psychic damage on every hit.

unlocks.condition: Carve the name of a living target into the blade's flat while speaking their name aloud.
unlocks.reward: Against your Marked Target: +3d8 piercing damage, attacks made with advantage, they cannot become invisible within 1 mile of you. You always know their direction and distance. Mark resets only on their death.

unlocks.condition: Kill the person you loved most. Must be a genuine relationship recognized by the GM.
unlocks.reward: +5 to all attack and damage rolls with this weapon. You can no longer lie in any form — the blade rings and the truth is spoken in your voice. Cannot remove attunement without a Wish spell.

name: Thornmaul
flavorText: A warhammer grown from petrified heartwood of a corrupted treant.

unlocks.condition: Deal the killing blow to 15 plant-type creatures or treants with this weapon.
unlocks.reward: Root choice on hit: Restrain target (1d8 piercing per turn, DC 16 Strength action to escape). Roots persist even if you drop the weapon.

unlocks.condition: Bring this weapon to a corrupted or dying ancient forest and let a druid or nature deity witness you striking a living tree with it.
unlocks.reward: The maul awakens. Speak with Plants and Commune with Nature simultaneously as a 1-minute ritual, once per day. +2 to attack and damage (total +6). Empathic communication with plants within 60 ft.

unlocks.condition: Strike down an innocent creature sheltering beneath a living tree, knowingly.
unlocks.reward: You take 1d4 piercing damage when gripping the weapon. Critical hits now entangle ALL creatures within 20 ft. +2d8 piercing on critical hits. Difficult terrain of vines appears within 15 ft. of any creature you kill.

name: The Last Word
flavorText: An elven longbow strung with a lock of hair from a dying god.

unlocks.condition: Kill 10 creatures using this bow without speaking a word during those encounters. Complete silence.
unlocks.reward: Arrows are completely silent — including impact. Advantage on Stealth while holding this bow and not speaking. Cannot be heard when nocking an arrow.

unlocks.condition: Draw this bow in the presence of a deity or divine avatar (CR 20+) and loose an arrow at them.
unlocks.reward: Against creatures with Legendary Resistance: hits reduce their remaining uses by 1. Once per day: silence a spell being verbalized — the spell fails with no slot expended.

unlocks.condition: Spend a full long rest in quiet at the grave, relic site, or final resting place of the god whose hair strings this bow.
unlocks.reward: The bow speaks one word to you — the name of the thing you most fear losing. Once per week: loose an arrow that cannot miss any named target on any plane — it travels around corners, through walls, across planes if needed.

name: Grudgebearer
flavorText: A dwarven battleaxe carried by seven generations of mountain kings.

unlocks.condition: Carry at least 3 unhealed wounds simultaneously and win a combat encounter.
unlocks.reward: The +1d6 per unhealed wound cap (previously +3d6) is removed — no limit on stacking. The blade permanently smells of old iron.

unlocks.condition: Engrave 5 or more names of genuine enemies into the haft using the axe's blade.
unlocks.reward: Against any named creature: +2d10 damage per hit. Reducing a named target to 0 HP restores 10 HP to you. The axe pulses when any named creature is within 30 ft.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The Grudge That Eats (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Spare someone whose name is on the haft — fully and knowingly — in front of witnesses.
unlocks.reward: +4 attack and damage permanently. However: any creature you reduce to 0 HP dies outright — no stabilizing, no prisoners. This cannot be undone while attuned.

name: Nightsong (Paired Daggers)
flavorText: A matched pair of curved daggers forged by shadow-dancers who worked only by moonlight.

unlocks.condition: Perform 20 Sneak Attacks or hidden hits using these daggers.
unlocks.reward: Teleport range increases from 10 to 30 ft. Destination now includes any shadow cast by a Medium or larger creature. Darkvision 120 ft. and see through magical darkness while both daggers are drawn.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Choir of Blades
unlocks.condition: Kill 5 named NPCs using both daggers in the same encounter within the same night.
unlocks.reward: When you teleport, bring one willing creature of your size or smaller. Hear hostile intent half a second before a blow — advantage on initiative, cannot be surprised while both daggers are drawn.

unlocks.condition: Accept a contract to kill someone, then refuse to complete it after accepting payment.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned — cannot remove voluntarily. On a killing blow: all creatures within 30 ft. make DC 16 Wisdom save or are Frightened. On a kill: absorb one of the target's proficiencies for 24 hours. Cannot be charmed.

name: Bonecrusher, the Giant's Toy
flavorText: An enormous maul once belonging to a hill giant chieftain, later cursed and abandoned.

unlocks.condition: Deal the killing blow to 5 giants using this weapon.
unlocks.reward: +4d6 bludgeoning on hits against giants. Giants you kill cannot be resurrected or raised as undead — their bones crumble to gravel.

unlocks.condition: Defeat a giant clan's chieftain in single combat and claim their title by tradition.
unlocks.reward: Giant's Decree: once per day, giants within 120 ft. make DC 18 Wisdom save or obey one command for 1 round. Giants who fail have disadvantage on attacks against you permanently.

unlocks.condition: Tell a genuinely funny joke while wielding this weapon in front of at least 5 witnesses who all laugh involuntarily.
unlocks.reward: The maul's low rattling chuckle is constant and audible within 30 ft. — cannot be stealthy. In exchange: on a critical hit, all enemies within 30 ft. make DC 18 Wisdom save or spend their next action laughing (Incapacitated).

name: The Fair Warning
flavorText: A masterwork siege crossbow that ended a famous siege with a single bolt from three hundred yards.

unlocks.condition: Fire the opening shot in 5 different military conflicts or sieges, witnessed by at least 10 combatants.
unlocks.reward: Range increases to 400/1600. The no-miss bolt can also pin targets to surfaces — Restrained until bolt removed (DC 17 Strength action).

unlocks.condition: Fire the bolt that ends a war — witnessed by leaders of both sides, precipitating peace or surrender.
unlocks.reward: No-miss bolt upgrades: can curve around full cover and hit targets not in line of sight, if seen within 10 minutes. Creatures killed cannot be resurrected without a Wish spell.

unlocks.condition: Refuse to fire when given a clear shot at a primary enemy (tyrant, lich, dragon in range) when the GM signals the moment.
unlocks.reward: Future no-miss shots require DC 15 Wisdom save or fire at nearest creature regardless of allegiance. In exchange: every kill visible to allies grants them 5 temporary HP.

name: Frosthowl
flavorText: A greatsword of blue-white steel, always rimed with frost.

unlocks.condition: Spend 7 consecutive days in extreme cold (below -30°F) without magical protection, while attuned.
unlocks.reward: Movement in snow/ice +10 ft. Immune to the Slowed condition from cold. Target's speed reduction from hits lasts until end of their next turn OR until they deal fire damage.

unlocks.condition: Kill 10 wolves or winter wolves. On the 10th, let the wolf see you clearly before it dies — do not strike from hiding.
unlocks.reward: Once per day: summon 4 Winter Wolves for 1 hour. While the pack is present, all cold damage from you or the wolves ignores resistance.

unlocks.condition: Challenge and defeat a Winter Wolf Elder (CR 8+) or Frost Giant Jarl in single combat — no allies may assist.
unlocks.reward: Exalted state. Cone of Cold (DC 18, 12d8) usable twice per day. Cold damage ignores immunity. You permanently sprout subtle wolf-like features while attuned.

name: Coinsplitter (Twin Shortswords)
flavorText: A pair of short swords forged from melted-down coins.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Sleight of the Blade
unlocks.condition: Successfully steal 1,000 gp total value using these blades' pickpocket ability, across any hits.
unlocks.reward: Pickpocket now lifts any item the target carries — including weapons, foci, or spell components. Once per day, a hit also duplicates one gold coin from the target's pouch.

unlocks.condition: Sell 5,000 gp worth of stolen goods to the same fence or black market contact over multiple sessions.
unlocks.reward: Coin Magnetism: aware of all currency within 30 ft. Cannot be robbed. Gold you spend has 10% chance (roll d10, on 10) to return to your purse by end of day.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The House Always Wins (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Gamble away at least 500 gp in one session and lose it all intentionally — knowing you will lose.
unlocks.reward: Luck Inversion: enemy critical hits against you become normal hits. However: gold above 100 gp disappears at end of each long rest — taken by the swords' original owner.

name: Aegis of the Last Stand
flavorText: Plate armor forged from the melted shields of a hundred knights who held a doomed line.

unlocks.condition: Be reduced to 0 HP, survive using the armor's 1 HP ability, and remain standing until the end of that combat.
unlocks.reward: The save-from-0-HP ability now triggers twice per long rest. When it triggers, the bell-ring grants all allies within 60 ft. 1d10 temporary HP.

unlocks.condition: Protect an ally from lethal damage 10 times — step between them and an attack that would have killed them.
unlocks.reward: Resistance to all damage while below 50 HP. Once per long rest as a reaction: take all remaining damage from an attack that would kill an ally — they drop to 1 HP instead.

unlocks.condition: Survive a battle where at least 5 allies die and you do not flee — be the last one standing, surrounded by enemies.
unlocks.reward: Cannot die while any ally within 30 ft. is conscious. When finally the last one standing: all enemies within 60 ft. take 10d10 radiant (no save). You choose to die or survive at 1 HP. Fallen allies' names etch inside the armor.

name: Cloak of the Hundred Faces
flavorText: A spymaster's cloak sewn from a hundred discarded illusions.

unlocks.condition: Maintain a single disguise for 30 consecutive in-game days without being discovered by any NPC who knew you before.
unlocks.reward: Perfectly replicate voice, mannerisms, and phrasing of anyone you've spoken with for 10+ minutes. Insight checks against your disguise have disadvantage even against Truesight of 7th level or lower.

unlocks.condition: Successfully impersonate 10 different named NPCs, each convincingly enough that they're fooled.
unlocks.reward: Stored faces held permanently. Switch between any stored face as a bonus action. Access surface memories of that person — their name, occupation, family, and last action. Feel their emotions faintly.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The Hundred Become One (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Go 10 consecutive in-game days without speaking or writing your own name — not even in private.
unlocks.reward: Your original face is gone. The cloak cycles through stored faces randomly while you sleep. +4 Charisma. Those who knew you feel unsettled even seeing your original face — they sense something is wrong but cannot articulate it.

name: Ironhide Vestments
flavorText: Chain from the hide of an ironback boar that took a village three days to bring down.

unlocks.condition: Be struck by 50 total piercing attacks while wearing this armor (cumulative).
unlocks.reward: Immunity to mundane piercing weapons (non-magical). Resistance to slashing damage added. The grunt gives 1 round of advance warning before ambushes.

unlocks.condition: Press this armor against the blood of a freshly killed boar or large beast once per month for 3 consecutive months.
unlocks.reward: Gore attack (1d10+Str, bonus action). On a charge (20+ ft. straight): 3d10+Str instead. AC increases to 19. While below half HP: all attacks deal +2d6 piercing damage.

unlocks.condition: Refuse to retreat from 5 separate encounters where retreat would have been tactically correct, surviving each one.
unlocks.reward: Cannot flee — movement away from nearest enemy costs double. In exchange: resistance to all damage while you haven't moved more than 10 ft. in the previous round. +2 AC when you don't move on your turn.

name: Shield of the Unbroken Line
flavorText: A tower shield passed down an unbroken line of border-guard captains for three centuries.

unlocks.condition: Use the shield's damage-reduction reaction 10 times.
unlocks.reward: Reaction now usable twice per day. When triggered, allies within 10 ft. also take 0 damage from the same attack (not just half).

unlocks.condition: Carry this shield into 3 different wars, sieges, or declared military conflicts.
unlocks.reward: The Line Holds: while you haven't moved this round, you and all allies within 10 ft. have resistance to all damage. Moving ends this effect until your next turn.

unlocks.condition: Stand between an unarmed civilian and certain death, take the killing blow yourself, and survive — the civilian must live.
unlocks.reward: AC bonus increases to +4. Once per long rest: create a 30-ft wall of force lasting 1 minute — all attacks against creatures behind it miss automatically. The shield names itself and will tell you in a dream.

name: Boots of the Wanderer King
flavorText: Worn by a king who walked away from his own coronation.

unlocks.condition: Travel more than 500 miles from where you started your adventuring career while wearing these boots.
unlocks.reward: Your walking speed increases by 10 ft. while wearing them, and you no longer need food or water while traveling (you still benefit from consuming them if available).

unlocks.condition: Visit 10 settlements you have never set foot in before while wearing these boots.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, sense the direction and rough distance to any specific place or person you have previously visited or met, not just the nearest settlement.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier III — The King Never Rests (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Go 30 consecutive days without sleeping in the same location twice.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. You cannot be tracked by non-magical means and are immune to exhaustion caused by travel, but you gain disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened while indoors within a building you own or call home.

name: Gauntlets of the Iron Handshake
flavorText: Forged for a diplomat famous for ending a war with a spine-cracking handshake.

unlocks.condition: Win 10 grapple or shove contests while wearing these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Unarmed strike damage increases to 1d10 bludgeoning. Advantage on checks and saves to resist being grappled, restrained, or shoved.

unlocks.condition: Successfully intimidate 15 different creatures while wearing these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Once per short rest, a successful unarmed strike can stun the target until the end of its next turn (DC 15 Constitution save negates).

unlocks.condition: Reduce a creature to 0 hit points with an unarmed strike from these gauntlets.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. Your unarmed strikes count as magical and deal an extra 1d6 damage, but you have disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks — people who've heard what your hands can do don't relax around you.

name: Helm of the Second Sight
flavorText: Worn by an oracle who saw her own death three times and changed the outcome each time.

unlocks.condition: Use the helm's act-first ability in 5 different encounters where you were not the highest initiative.
unlocks.reward: Act-first ability upgrades to twice per day. Once per day, the GM gives a cryptic single-sentence hint about what will happen in the next encounter before it begins.

unlocks.condition: Deliberately allow a future you foresaw to happen without attempting to prevent it, and let it play out.
unlocks.reward: True Prophecy once per week: meditate 1 hour, the GM describes one event in specific detail occurring within 7 in-game days. You cannot change this event — but you can prepare.

unlocks.condition: Witness your own death in a vision and accept it without attempting to deny or prevent it.
unlocks.reward: Truesight 60 ft. permanently. Once per day: ask the GM one yes/no question about the future — they must answer honestly. Once per long rest: rewind 6 seconds for the entire battlefield (everyone retains memory of what happened).

name: Robes of the Still Storm
flavorText: Woven by a monastic order trained in the eye of a hurricane.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Eye of the Storm
unlocks.condition: Maintain concentration on a spell for its full maximum duration in 10 separate encounters while taking damage each time.
unlocks.reward: Concentration spells last twice as long (up to their listed max, then doubled). Once per encounter: automatically succeed one Constitution save to maintain concentration.

unlocks.condition: Find and spend one week in meditation at the storm-wracked mountain monastery where these robes were woven.
unlocks.reward: Tempest Form once per day for 1 minute: partially incorporeal (immune to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing). Constant Gust of Wind 30-ft radius. Move through other creatures' spaces. Ignore difficult terrain.

unlocks.condition: Strike a monk or druid engaged in peaceful meditation without warning while they are defenseless.
unlocks.reward: Constant thunder aura — cannot be stealthy. In exchange: while Incorporeal, melee attackers take 2d8 thunder damage. Spells deal +2d6 thunder. Immune to thunder and lightning damage.

name: Elixir of the Phoenix's Breath
flavorText: Distilled from a single feather shed willingly by a phoenix.

unlocks.condition: Use an Elixir of the Phoenix's Breath (or another found later) to stabilize or revive an ally on 3 separate occasions.
unlocks.reward: Future uses restore an additional 2d4 HP, and the harmless warm flame grants the target resistance to fire damage for 1 minute.

unlocks.condition: Use the elixir on an ally who was reduced to 0 HP by fire damage.
unlocks.reward: When used on a creature at 0 HP, that creature also removes one exhaustion level and stands up with 1 temporary hit point that lingers until the start of their next turn.

name: Draught of a Thousand Faces
flavorText: An opalescent potion brewed for a client who was never named.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Face Worth Keeping
unlocks.condition: Successfully deceive 5 different creatures using a disguise granted by this draught (or another of its kind).
unlocks.reward: The disguise now also alters your voice to match, and lasts for 48 hours instead of 24.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Nobody You've Ever Been
unlocks.condition: Use the draught's disguise to infiltrate a location you could not otherwise have entered.
unlocks.reward: You may now also mimic the exact voice and minor mannerisms of anyone you've spent at least 10 minutes observing, in addition to their appearance.

name: Vial of Borrowed Time
flavorText: A silvery liquid that moves against the current of its vial.

unlocks.condition: Use a Vial of Borrowed Time to directly turn the tide of a combat you would otherwise likely have lost.
unlocks.reward: The exhaustion level gained afterward is removed automatically after your next short rest instead of requiring a long rest.

unlocks.condition: Use 3 Vials of Borrowed Time within the same 7-day period.
unlocks.reward: You may act twice on your next turn as normal, but immediately after your following turn, you gain 2 levels of exhaustion instead of 1 for that use only.

name: Scroll of the Final Verse
flavorText: A scroll of singing script — the last spell a legendary archmage cast before retiring.

unlocks.condition: Use the scroll to cast a spell that saves an ally's life.
unlocks.reward: You may cast the spell without needing to have personally witnessed anyone cast it, so long as you know of the spell by name and general effect.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Song Doesn't End
unlocks.condition: Successfully cast 3 different 6th-level spells using scrolls of this kind over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: The musical-note ash the scroll leaves behind can be gathered and used as a divine focus for your next spell cast within 1 minute, granting a +1 bonus to its save DC.

name: Powdered Star-Iron
flavorText: A pouch of silvery dust ground from a fragment of a fallen star.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Iron From the Sky
unlocks.condition: Use star-iron-coated weapons to deal a combined 100 damage to creatures normally resistant or immune to non-magical damage.
unlocks.reward: The coating now lasts 8 hours instead of 1, and the bonus damage increases to 1d8.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — The Weapon Remembers the Stars
unlocks.condition: Coat 5 different weapons with star-iron powder over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: You can now coat two weapons from a single application (yours and one ally's, or two of your own), so long as both are coated within the same minute.

name: Tears of the Unburied Queen
flavorText: A crystal vial of tears wept by a queen who refused to die before finishing her revenge.

unlocks.condition: Use the tears to cure a curse or disease on an ally, not yourself.
unlocks.reward: Future uses restore an additional 2d10 HP, and the weeping period no longer causes disadvantage on Perception checks during it.

unlocks.condition: Use 3 vials of these tears over the course of your adventures.
unlocks.reward: The cure effect now also removes one level of exhaustion in addition to curing curses and disease.

name: The Gambler's Last Coin
flavorText: A tarnished coin that has never once landed the way its holder wanted — except when it mattered most.

unlocks.condition: Use the coin's reroll ability 10 times and have at least 7 produce a better result than the original.
unlocks.reward: Once per day: reroll any creature's die roll within 60 ft. (yours or theirs) and choose either result. The coin now spins for 15 seconds instead of 10 before falling.

unlocks.condition: Win a wager of at least 500 gp against unfavorable odds without using the coin's ability.
unlocks.reward: Probability Sense: always know approximate odds of any proposed course of action (GM tells you: good, even, poor, or terrible odds). Cannot be cheated at games of chance.

unlocks.condition: Lose a bet on something genuinely important — wagered something you could not afford to lose and lost it, without using magic to change the outcome.
unlocks.reward: Once per week: an unknown benefactor provides one service or clears one debt (GM determines form). However: once per month the coin calls in its own favor — GM chooses what you must do. Refusing costs you 3 automatic reroll failures.

name: Signet of the Forgotten House
flavorText: A heavy signet ring bearing the crest of a house erased from every record.

unlocks.condition: Research and document the complete history of the Forgotten House — its name, members, and how it was erased — and present this to a historian or court.
unlocks.reward: Any door, vault, or lock bearing a noble crest opens at your touch. Noble NPCs treat you as a peer regardless of your actual title.

unlocks.condition: Spend at least 1,000 gp to restore, rebuild, or formally re-establish the Forgotten House in some capacity.
unlocks.reward: Gain a loyal retainer from the restored house who cannot be bought, charmed, or deceived into betrayal. Once per day: cast Sending without components to any noble or ruling-class member on the plane.

unlocks.condition: Have yourself deliberately erased from an official record — your name removed from a census, guild roster, or kingdom's birth records — by your own hand.
unlocks.reward: Creatures who meet you have disadvantage on checks to recall your appearance or name 24 hours later. Once per week: erase one NPC's memory of you completely (DC 18 Wisdom to resist). Your name fades from documents written by others within 1 month.

name: The Hourglass That Lies
flavorText: A palm-sized hourglass whose sand does not fall at a consistent rate.

unlocks.condition: Use the 6-second rewind ability 20 times.
unlocks.reward: Rewind now covers 12 seconds (2 rounds). You retain memory of all actions in the rewound period — effective foreknowledge.

unlocks.condition: Find and identify the hourglass's maker — their name, their era, and why they made something that lies about time.
unlocks.reward: Once per week: fast-forward instead of rewind — skip 1 round entirely (your turn doesn't occur, nothing acts against you, you emerge at next round's start fully rid of one condition).

unlocks.condition: Convince someone of something completely false — a lie that genuinely changes their long-term behavior — using the hourglass's temporal aura to make the lie feel like memory.
unlocks.reward: The hourglass stops lying. Once per day: see exactly 6 seconds into the future with certainty — not a guess, but true knowledge of what will happen next round in initiative order, including all enemy actions and targets.

name: Compass of the Wayward Star
flavorText: An old brass compass that has never pointed north.

unlocks.condition: Use the compass to knowingly walk toward whatever it points at, 5 separate times.
unlocks.reward: You may now ask the compass to instead point toward what you most hope to find, once per long rest, though it may still show what you fear if the two are closely entangled.

unlocks.condition: Confront and overcome the specific thing the compass revealed you feared.
unlocks.reward: The compass no longer spins wildly when pointed at your own reflection — instead it points true north, functioning as a reliable compass whenever you don't need it to be anything more.

name: Mask of the Silent Choir
flavorText: A plain wooden mask worn by a monastery that vowed never to be heard again.

unlocks.condition: Go an entire adventuring day without speaking above a whisper while wearing the mask.
unlocks.reward: You gain advantage on Stealth checks made to avoid being heard, in addition to the mask's existing effects.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — A Harmony of One
unlocks.condition: Successfully sneak past 10 creatures who should reasonably have heard you, while wearing the mask.
unlocks.reward: Once per long rest, the mask's hum can be directed at one creature within 30 ft. as an action — DC 15 Wisdom save or that creature is charmed for 1 minute, perceiving the hum as a lullaby.

name: The Debt Collector's Ledger
flavorText: A heavy leather ledger that binds any debt spoken aloud into its pages.

unlocks.condition: Successfully compel 5 favors using the Ledger's Geas ability.
unlocks.reward: Debts can compound into standing obligations — ongoing service instead of a single act. Up to 3 active obligations at once.

unlocks.condition: Collect on a debt from a king, deity, or CR 20+ entity — the favor must actually be delivered.
unlocks.reward: Once per month, the Ledger informs you of one significant obligation a powerful creature (CR 15+) has to the world. You can call it in as if written in your Ledger — they cannot refuse.

unlocks.condition: Forgive a debt — intentionally release someone from an obligation in the Ledger with nothing in return, in genuine goodwill.
unlocks.reward: The Ledger begins recording debts owed to you by the universe. Once per day: spend a debt-credit to declare that something that just failed (a roll, an action) succeeded instead. The universe owed you this one.

name: Hammer of Thunderbolts
flavorText: A massive warhammer with a head the size of a man's chest, inscribed with storm runes.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — Thunder Remembers Its Name
unlocks.condition: Score a killing blow against a giant using this hammer.
unlocks.reward: The giant-slaying bonus damage increases to 3d6, and the hammer's thrown range increases to 30/90.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier II — Worthy of the Storm (Curse)
unlocks.condition: Defeat 5 giants total with this hammer.
unlocks.reward: Permanently attuned. On any critical hit, the target is also stunned until the end of its next turn (DC 17 Constitution save negates), but each throw leaves your hands numb — disadvantage on Dexterity checks requiring fine manipulation for 1 minute after each throw.

name: Lyre of Building
flavorText: A silver-strung lyre with a resonant wooden body.

unlocks.tierLabel: Tier I — A Song for Foundations
unlocks.condition: Use the lyre to protect a structure that is later actually attacked while the protection is active.
unlocks.reward: The protective radius increases to 500 ft., and structures within it also can't be damaged by natural disasters (fire, flood, earthquake) while you play.
